rules.condition: APB side idle, i_apb_psel = 1 and i_apb_penable = 0 (Setup phase)
rules.statement: The bridge shall capture the request at the rising edge ending the Setup cycle.
The bridge shall present the request on TL-UL channel A from flip-flops in the next cycle (first Access cycle).

rules.condition: APB write with PSTRB = 4'b1111 and PADDR[1:0] = 2'b00
rules.statement: The bridge shall convert it into one PutFullData (a_opcode = 3'b000) with a_size = 2, a_mask = 4'b1111, a_address = PADDR and a_data = PWDATA.
The bridge shall convert it into one TL-UL Get (a_opcode = 3'b100) with a_size = 2, a_mask = 4'b1111 and a_address = PADDR.
PSTRB shall be ignored on reads.
The bridge shall have at most one TL-UL request outstanding.
The bridge shall start no new TL-UL request before the APB completion of the previous transfer.

rules.condition: From the cycle after capture until i_tlul_a_ready is sampled high
rules.statement: The bridge shall keep o_tlul_a_valid high and channel A stable.
The bridge shall return the TL-UL d_data on o_apb_prdata.

rules.condition: Write completion or any error completion
rules.statement: The bridge shall drive o_apb_prdata to 0.

rules.condition: TL-UL response arrives when no request has been accepted (orphan)
rules.statement: The bridge shall discard the response without any effect on the APB side.
The bridge shall detect the Setup phase from levels i_apb_psel = 1 and i_apb_penable = 0, not from an edge of i_apb_psel.

rules.condition: New Setup phase in the cycle immediately after the PREADY cycle, whether psel stays 1 or returns to 0 for one or more cycles
rules.statement: The bridge shall accept the new transfer.
Every combination of read, write and error transfers shall be supported back to back.
The bridge shall expose exactly the APB4 Completer signals listed in section 6.2 and no other APB signal.
The bridge shall expose exactly the TL-UL host signals listed in section 6.2 and no others.

rules.condition: Output port changes value during operation
rules.statement: Such output ports shall be driven directly by a flip-flop Q pin with no combinational logic; never-changing outputs are constant tie-offs.
The bridge shall assert o_apb_pready for exactly one cycle per transfer, and only in an Access cycle (psel = 1, penable = 1).
o_apb_pslverr shall be 1 only while o_apb_pready is 1.
The bridge shall drive a_param = 3'b000, a_size = 2'b10, a_mask = 4'b1111, a_source = PARA_SRC_ID and a_user = '0.
The bridge shall drive o_tlul_d_ready low.

rules.condition: From first clock edge after reset release
rules.statement: The bridge shall drive o_tlul_d_ready high and keep it high.
APB-facing and TL-UL-facing logic shall be in two separate modules connected only through the internal interface of section 5.1.
The bridge shall issue no TL-UL request and complete with PREADY = 1 and PSLVERR = 1 in the first Access cycle.
The bridge shall issue no TL-UL request and complete with PREADY = 1 and PSLVERR = 1 in the first Access cycle.
The bridge shall complete the APB transfer with PSLVERR = 1.

rules.condition: Response d_opcode is not AccessAckData (3'b001) for a read or not AccessAck (3'b000) for a write
rules.statement: The bridge shall complete the APB transfer with PSLVERR = 1.
The bridge shall complete the APB transfer with PSLVERR = 1.
The bridge shall operate in one clock domain, i_clk_core, for both interfaces with no clock-domain crossing.
The bridge shall use active-low reset i_rst_n_core with asynchronous assertion.
The bridge shall drive the listed outputs to 0 while reset is asserted.
The bridge shall abandon the transfer and send no APB completion for it after reset release.
The bridge shall accept only parameter values listed in section 8; an illegal value shall be reported at elaboration.

rules.condition: Device accepts request in first cycle and returns response in the following cycle
rules.statement: The APB Access phase shall last 3 cycles (2 wait states).

rules.condition: Device returns response in the cycle it accepts the request
rules.statement: The APB Access phase shall last 2 cycles (1 wait state).
The completion shall last 1 Access cycle with no wait state.
A new Setup phase shall be accepted in the cycle after PREADY.
Setup-to-Setup interval shall be the minimum: 4 cycles with prompt device, 3 with same-cycle response, 2 after local error, with no idle cycle added.
The RTL shall comply with REF-003 and use the hierarchy of section 14.2.
An APB protocol checker and the REF-005 TL-UL protocol checker shall be bound to the ports.
The RTL shall be scan-insertable: no latch, combinational loop, internal tri-state, clock gating, or gated/derived clock.
